name: HMI Fault — SG-1 Level Frozen On Screen
description: The displayed SG-1 level is frozen at a normal value while feedwater is lost and the real level falls. The control system and protection use the true reading, so auxiliary feedwater and the low-low level reactor trip still act — but the operator's gauge looks fine until they cross-check other indications.
briefing: From t+30 s the SG-1 level indication is stuck at ~65%. Shortly after, both feedwater pumps trip. Do NOT trust the frozen gauge: use SG-2, feed/steam flow mismatch, steam pressure and the alarm/CSF panels to work out the real situation.
learning_objectives: An HMI-layer fault changes only what the operator sees — not the plant or its automation
Cross-checking a suspect indication against independent parameters
Recognising that alarms and safety-function status can contradict a gauge, and why the gauge is the one that is wrong
